FieldDefinition.description: When true, DEBUG-tier PARLER_HITL decision_rejected lines also log at WARN for this agent (lab). Restart this Thing after changing; save-only may not refresh registration. See docs/agent/AGENT-ALWAYSON-TWX.md and ParlerHitlAuditLog.

FieldDefinition.aspect.defaultValue: You are a ThingWorx AI assistant. Use the available tools to help the user interact with the ThingWorx platform.
FieldDefinition.description: Default system prompt. Can be overridden per Chat call.
FieldDefinition.name: systemPrompt

FieldDefinition.description: Max UTF-16 code units (Java String length) for one large-table CSV before Parler skips export (skipped_limit). Platform SaveText still applies; this caps agent-side CSV materialization. Clamped 1_000_000..200_000_000.
FieldDefinition.name: tableCsvExportMaxChars

FieldDefinition.description: When a table's totalRows exceeds this integer, or totalRows is greater than the inline row count, the agent attempts UTF-8 CSV export via SaveText on exportFileRepository before emitting type:table.
FieldDefinition.name: tableCsvExportRowThreshold

FieldDefinition.description: Controls LLM-visible taxonomy prompt injection: full_table (default), resolver_guidance_only, or none. See docs/agent/taxonomy.md.
FieldDefinition.name: taxonomyPromptInjection

FieldDefinition.description: Sampling temperature (0.0–2.0). Lower = more deterministic.
FieldDefinition.name: temperature

FieldDefinition.description: Tool-schema admission mode: off (default; advertise all tools), narrow (drop irrelevant tool buckets up front by deterministic host-context/intent signals, keep the core set), or lazy (opt-in; advertise only the core set plus a load_tool_schemas meta-tool whose catalog lets the model load tool schemas on demand). Unknown/blank means off. See docs/operations/tool-schema-admission-control.md.
FieldDefinition.name: toolAdmissionMode

This listing is limited to a maximum number of machines based on the UtilizationConfiguration "MaxEntitiesOnOverviewScreen" on the PTCSC.UtilizationTWImpl.Manager thing.
